annotation.title_clean: Action Plan for the Innovation and Development of the Robotics Industry in Beijing (2019-2022)
annotation.title_en: Action Plan for the Innovation and Development of the Robotics Industry in Beijing (2019-2022)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Beijing Municipality (published by Beijing Investment Promotion Bureau)
annotation.summary_en: Beijing municipal industrial action plan (2019-2022) to foster a "4+1" robotics industry covering healthcare, special-purpose, collaborative and warehouse/logistics robots plus essential components. It sets innovation and revenue targets and promotes demonstration applications, talent training and international cooperation. It contains no safety or ethics regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Develop a '4+1' pattern: healthcare, special-purpose, collaborative, warehouse/logistics robots and essential components
Target more than RMB 12 billion robotics industry revenue and 2-3 world-leading enterprises
Build over three national-level collaborative innovation platforms
Promote demonstration applications in factories, public safety, emergency rescue and logistics
Support talent training and international exchange via World Robot Conference and overseas R&D centres
